commands.title: AOS-CX version
commands.description: Show switch platform, AOS-CX software, build, and service OS versions.

commands.title: System information
commands.description: Show hostname, product, base MAC, serial number, uptime, and system state.

commands.title: Interface brief
commands.description: Summarize interface administrative, link, speed, and VLAN state.

commands.title: Interface details
commands.description: Inspect state, addressing, rates, errors, media, and counters on one interface.

commands.title: Interface statistics
commands.description: Show packets, bytes, errors, discards, and utilization across interfaces.

commands.title: VLAN table
commands.description: Show VLAN IDs, names, status, and tagged or untagged members.

commands.title: MAC address table
commands.description: Show learned and static MAC entries by VLAN and interface.

commands.title: ARP table
commands.description: Display IPv4 neighbors across virtual routing and forwarding instances.

commands.title: IPv4 route table
commands.description: Show IPv4 routes, protocols, distances, metrics, and next hops across VRFs.

commands.title: BGP summary
commands.description: Summarize BGP peers, state, uptime, and prefix counts across VRFs.

commands.title: OSPF neighbors
commands.description: Show OSPF neighbor identity, state, dead time, and interface across VRFs.

commands.title: LLDP neighbor details
commands.description: Show neighbor system, port, management address, and advertised capabilities.

commands.title: Spanning-tree state
commands.description: Show root, bridge, topology changes, port roles, and forwarding state.

commands.title: LACP interfaces
commands.description: Show link aggregation groups, actors, partners, state flags, and member health.

commands.title: VSX brief
commands.description: Summarize VSX role, ISL, keepalive, configuration synchronization, and peer state.

commands.title: VSX synchronization status
commands.description: Show VSX configuration synchronization categories and consistency failures.

commands.title: Recent events
commands.description: Show switch events in reverse order; output may include sensitive infrastructure context.

commands.title: Environmental health
commands.description: Show temperature sensor values, limits, and alarm state.

commands.title: Power over Ethernet summary
commands.description: Show PoE availability, consumption, and per-port delivery state.

commands.title: Running configuration
commands.description: Display active configuration, which can contain sensitive network and authentication data.
